1_godel_knot.question: Can CTMS validate itself?
1_godel_knot.insight: System cannot prove its own consistency (Gödel's 2nd Theorem)

3_observer_effect.question: Can we know security state without changing it?
3_observer_effect.insight: Security exists as probability distribution until measured

4_liars_paradox.question: Who reviews the code review system?

5_ship_of_theseus.question: Is continuously deployed system the same system?
5_ship_of_theseus.insight: Identity is topological, not material - preserved through continuous deformation

6_russell_set.question: Does non-compliant set include its definition?
6_russell_set.insight: Local contradictions don't cause global explosion

7_quantum_commit.question: Which reviewer approved first in distributed system?
7_quantum_commit.insight: Use causal graphs, not absolute timestamps

8_infinite_why.question: When does the chain of 'why' terminate?

9_uncertainty_principle.question: Can we know exact behavior AND exact coverage?
9_uncertainty_principle.insight: Testing provides confidence intervals, not binary pass/fail

10_axiom_of_choice.question: Can we choose secure deps from infinite configs?
10_axiom_of_choice.insight: Use formal verification, not exhaustive search
